[[File:Chris DeJong DecipherCon 1999 sat47.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Chris DeJong at [[DecipherCon 1999]]. Photo: Decipher.]]
'''Chris DeJong''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Red 68 in the Alderaan region, from Davis, California.<ref name="decsq-alderaan" /> His slot was later marked Retired.<ref name="sm-fan" />

At [[DecipherCon 1999]] Decipher photographed "Star Trek CCG finalist Chris DeJong of Davis, California" on Saturday 13 November 1999.<ref name="sat47">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/SAT/sat47.html DecipherCon 1999 photo sat47], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000711124430/http://www.decipher.com:80/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/SAT/sat47.html Internet Archive]</ref>
